task_instance: Given a sample support ticket (blank analytics dashboard for a whole team, 500 errors from /api/v2/widgets, blocking dispatch), produce a full ticket-triage assessment following the skill's workflow: parse the issue, assign category/priority/product area using the skill's taxonomy and priority framework, apply the routing rules, note that duplicate/known-issue checks could not be run (no support platform/knowledge base/tracker access in this environment), and draft the suggested initial customer response plus internal notes, all per the skill's specified output template.
evidence: Created sample_ticket.txt (a realistic customer support message: blank dashboard, 12 users affected, /api/v2/widgets 500 errors, no workaround, blocking time-critical work). Created triage_output.md by applying the skill's core reasoning steps directly (parse issue -> categorize using the Category Taxonomy table -> assign priority using the P1-P4 Priority Framework -> pick product area -> apply Routing Rules table -> draft response using the Bug auto-response template -> write internal notes), producing output that follows the skill's exact required template (Triage header, Category/Priority/Product area line, Issue Summary, Key Details, Routing Recommendation, Suggested Initial Response, Internal Notes). Verified by re-reading triage_output.md against the template in SKILL.md section 5 and confirming every required field is present and the priority (P1) is correctly justified against the stated P1 criteria (production down, all/most users affected, no workaround, worsening scope). The one part of the workflow that could not be executed was step 3, 'Check for Duplicates and Known Issues', which requires searching a support platform, knowledge base, and project tracker (marked with '~~' in SKILL.md, i.e. optional/pluggable connectors) -- none of these exist in this offline, no-network, no-MCP-tools sandbox, so those fields were honestly marked 'Unknown/Checking' in the output rather than fabricated, matching the skill's own template option for when a check hasn't been done. This did not block the core deliverable (the categorized, prioritized, routed triage assessment with a suggested response), which is the actual thing a user invokes this skill for and was fully produced and verified.
